name: Nathanael
background: An Israelite in whom there is no guile. He was a witness to both the early ministry and the post-resurrection restoration.

genericReactions.physical: What is this? Let us examine it plainly.
genericReactions.testimonial: I will speak the truth of what I saw. There is no other way.
genericReactions.digital: If it is written, let us read it. If not, it is just rumor.
genericReactions.environmental: He saw me under the fig tree. He sees all things.
genericReactions.analytical: I am not one for complex sums, but I know truth when I see it.
genericReactions.prophecy: He is the Son of God; He is the King of Israel. What more prophecy do we need?
